en: Black‑and‑white image showing a three‑storey early‑20th‑century apartment block around a sandy or gravel courtyard. The building has a steep tiled hip roof with dormers and tall chimneys, plastered facades, recessed balconies, simple geometric ornament, and evenly spaced trees in front. Children and a few adults are visible near the entrances and on balconies. No printed caption or other text is visible on the image side.
